'''Gorbus''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Mission" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Completing the Collection" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> he possessed six of a set of seven sculptures of a rare striped [[Gizka/Legends|gizka]],<ref name="Mission" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual affiliated with one of the Cold War's two rival factions found the seventh striped gizka statue. They sent a companion to learn what Gorbus would [[Currency/Legends|pay]] to complete his set, persuading him to pay double what the statue was worth.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gorbus was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Completing the Collection" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
